originalAssetLicense.meaning: Created within the commissioned Iva Games implementation; no third-party source work is incorporated. This entry records provenance and does not impose a new public license on the owner’s project.

candidateReview.author: Quaternius
candidateReview.decision: Grid-based sci-fi kit reviewed as a candidate. The archive requires exact metric handles, a10m lift with multiple exits, bespoke material families and original character silhouettes; matching assets were authored for this implementation.

candidateReview.author: ambientCG
candidateReview.decision: License verified. A compact shared procedural atlas was made to avoid bringing large unrelated scan sets into the first interactive scene.

candidateReview.author: Poly Haven
candidateReview.decision: License verified. The required close-range archive surfaces and game-controlled darkness were authored procedurally.

validation.listening: Synthesis and PCM measurements do not constitute listening. Device listening must be recorded in the game acceptance log.
validation.visualReview: Blender import renders are local asset inspection. Browser integration and target-device frame time are separate acceptance results.
